prompt:
[FIGURE PLACEHOLDER: A displacement-time graph showing a straight line that starts at (0 s, -10 m) and passes through (5.0 s, +15 m).]
Determine the velocity of the object.

mark_scheme.criterion: Uses gradient = Delta s / Delta t with coordinates: (+15 - (-10)) / (5.0 - 0).
Velocity = +5.0 m s^-1 (or 5.0 m s^-1 in the positive direction)

hints: Be careful with signs when finding Delta s: (+15) - (-10).
Divide Delta s by the elapsed time Delta t = 5.0 s.
teacher_walkthrough: Delta t = 5.0 s. Gradient = 25 / 5.0 = +5.0 m s^-1.
